summary: Iteration 14 — Frontend-only UX fix verification: 'special mode panels (Passport / Group / Crawl) must be self-contained (guide + location + radius + own Deal button) so nothing requires scrolling up'. Tested at 390x844 mobile AND 768x1024 tablet against the live preview. ALL GREEN, ZERO console errors, ZERO page errors across every flow. (1) PASSPORT: passport-mode-toggle -> passport-picker + passport-setup render; main spin-roulette-button removed from DOM (count=0); 3-step numbered guide (ol > li = 3) rendered above ZIP/location/radius/CTA inside passport-setup; passport-setup-zip, passport-setup-use-location, passport-setup-radius-slider, passport-setup-cta all present; CTA label = 'Deal My Passport'. GEOMETRY @390x844: passport-picker y=69 (in viewport, top<844), CTA y=684, cta_y > picker_y (no upward scroll required from the picker to reach the CTA). E2E: filled 10001, picked passport-size-4, clicked passport-setup-cta -> nav to /p/JQB445, passport-progress='0/4', 4 stops rendered (Altair Restaurant NYC / Ci Siamo / Hudson Yards Tavern / +1). Manual stamp on stop 0 -> progress becomes '1/4', page stays functional (Undo stamp button appears). (2) GROUP: group-mode-toggle -> group-picker + group-setup render; spin count=0; steps=3; group-setup-zip/use-location/radius-slider/cta all present; CTA text = 'Pick 3 Spots' (light theme). Geometry: picker y=159, cta y=594. E2E: filled 10001 -> Pick 3 Spots -> 3 group picks dealt (6 [data-testid^=group-pick-] because each pick has 2 testIDs — pick body + vote button — verified visually: 'Anixi Mediterranean Vegan', 'Tavola Hells Kitchen', 'Hudson Yards Tavern' with Lock in random + Deal 3 again buttons). (3) CRAWL: crawl-mode-toggle -> crawl-type-picker renders; 3-step numbered guide (ol > li = 3); crawl-zip-a, crawl-radius-control, crawl-radius-slider, crawl-deal-button all present; spin=0. E2E: filled crawl-zip-a=10001 -> crawl-deal-button -> [role=dialog] opens with 6 crawl stops ('Your Pub Crawl — 6 stops in a followable route', map with numbered pins 1-6, Maggie Reilly's + The Tailor Public House listed, New crawl / Share with group CTAs, 0/6 conquered progress). (4) MUTUAL EXCLUSION: verified — enabling crawl while group was on -> group-picker disappears; enabling passport while crawl was on -> crawl-type-picker disappears; toggling passport off with none else on -> spin-roulette-button reappears (count=1). (5) REGRESSION @390x844: no special mode, top zip-input + radius-control still function, Food tab spin-roulette-button -> Skylight Diner reveal card with 'Order / Delivery' dropdown button (order-by-text=7 including sibling result cards), Share your fate + Shuffle again + Shop merch CTAs all render, zero errors. (6) TABLET @768x1024: passport toggle -> picker y=244 h=535, cta y=689 (in viewport, cta below picker). Fix is complete and matches the requested UX contract.
critical_code_review_comments: components/home/ModeSetup.jsx is clean & DRY: one reusable panel body for Passport & Group (Crawl still hand-rolls the same layout inline in Home.jsx around lines 1218-1319 because it needs zip-A/zip-B pair — not fixable without a bigger refactor, acceptable). Consider extracting the crawl-panel guide/CTA into ModeSetup with a showZipB slot in a future pass to fully DRY, but not blocking.

Home.jsx line 96-103: the scrollIntoView effect uses a 120ms timeout after mode change and picks by data-testid. Verified: at 390x844 the passport-picker lands at y=69 (top of viewport) which matches block:'center' on a 705px tall panel that would otherwise be much longer than the viewport; this is the correct behavior since 'center' clips at the container edge. No fix needed.

Home.jsx line 1071: the fallback CTA label logic on the (now hidden) spin-roulette-button still branches on passportMode/groupMode. Dead but harmless — the whole button is unmounted while any special mode is on. Not worth changing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 6/6 scenarios pass (Passport panel geometry + Passport e2e + Group panel + Group e2e + Crawl panel + Crawl e2e + Mutual exclusion + Normal-mode regression + Tablet width) with 0 console/page errors.

seed_data_creation: One live Fate Passport created against preview backend: code JQB445 (mode=food, ZIP 10001, 4 stops, 1/4 stamped as Altair Restaurant NYC via manual stamp). One transient crawl session opened (not persisted to backend beyond dialog).
context_for_next_testing_agent: (1) A guided intro modal ('Step 1/4 — What calls to you?') shows on a fresh session and MUST be dismissed via the top-right 'Skip intro' button (data-testid='skip-intro-button' or by role/name) before the main Home UI is usable — my script dismisses it in a small helper. (2) For the passport/group/crawl toggles, always call scroll_into_view_if_needed() before click(force=True) — the toggles sit inside the 'More ways to play' card which can be off-screen on first load. (3) When any special mode is on, spin-roulette-button is UNMOUNTED (not just hidden) — Home.jsx line 1060 gates its render. (4) group-pick-* testIDs show 6 not 3 because each dealt pick renders a body row + a vote button with the same testID prefix (verified visually, not a bug). (5) crawl-deal-button ships stops as a role=dialog rather than data-testid='crawl-dialog'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is a fix VERIFICATION, not a bug. The original UX complaint ('scrolling up to Deal / up further for radius/ZIP') is resolved because each special mode panel now embeds its own guide + ZIP + location + radius + CTA in reading order (top -> bottom), the main Deal button is unmounted while any special mode is on so it can't confuse users, and an effect scrollIntoView's the panel into center on toggle-on. All three panels verified at both mobile and tablet widths.
